title: dass21-engine-verification: reference engine, mutants, conformance harness and 35-vector test oracle for a DASS-21 screening and triage engine
description: Reference engine, 105 first-order mutants, mutation analysis scripts, conformance harness and the 35-vector test oracle accompanying the article Lattice-Aware Boundary and Mutation Testing of a DASS-21 Screening and Triage Engine. All inputs are synthetic response vectors; no participant data are included. The platform source code is not part of this archive.
